written: 2026-11-10, before any Milestone 3 model was scored

tuning.method: expanding season folds inside the training seasons; the validation season is not used for tuning
tuning.score: mean multiclass log loss over the three folds; the lowest wins

logistic_regression.preprocessing: mean imputation then standardization, both fitted on the training rows only

xgboost.preprocessing: none; missing values are handled by the trees

selection.rule: Start with the baseline as the choice. Take each more complex candidate in order. It replaces the current choice only if the 95% paired bootstrap interval for (candidate minus current choice) validation log loss lies entirely below zero. Otherwise the simpler model stays.
selection.sensitivity_only: Refit without 2020-21 and report the validation score. It is not used for selection.

bootstrap.method: percentile; resample validation matches with replacement, paired across models

final_test.fit_seasons: training plus validation seasons, with the frozen settings
reported: one third each as a reference
final_test.runs: once; a second run is refused
